results.name: Low Rotational Med Ball Chops (Quarter Squat, Rotating Med Ball Left and Right Across Core)
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width in a quarter squat, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Rotate your torso to bring the ball down to the outside of one hip.
Rotate back across your body, keeping the ball low as it rides across your core to the other hip.
Continue alternating sides in a smooth, controlled rhythm.
tips: Stay in the quarter squat throughout.
Pivot your feet slightly to protect your knees.
results.description: Low Rotational Med Ball Chops (Quarter Squat, Rotating Med Ball Left and Right Across Core) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Quadriceps, Glutes.

results.name: Low Sled Push
instructions: Grip the sled at the low handles, arms extended.
Lean forward so your torso is nearly parallel to the floor with a flat back.
Drive the sled forward with short, fast steps through the balls of your feet.
Keep pushing for the set distance.
tips: Keep your hips low and your back flat.
results.description: Low Sled Push is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a sled machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Hamstrings, Shoulders.

results.name: Lying Neck Curls
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head and neck past the end.
Let your head lower gently back until it is in line with the bench.
Tuck your chin and slowly curl your head up toward your chest.
Lower it back with control and repeat.
tips: Start with bodyweight only; add a towel-wrapped plate only when this is easy.
results.description: Lying Neck Curls is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the levator scapulae (neck). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Lying Neck Extension
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head and neck past the end.
Let your head lower gently toward the floor.
Slowly lift your head back until it is in line with your spine.
Lower it with control and repeat.
tips: Don't lift your head beyond a neutral line.
Move slowly and without weight at first.
results.description: Lying Neck Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the levator scapulae (neck). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Traps.

results.name: Lying on Side Arm Circle Warm Up
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and both arms extended in front of you at chest height.
Lift your top arm and draw a large circle over your head and behind you.
Let your chest open and your eyes follow your hand as the arm goes behind you.
Bring the arm back to the start and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your knees together and on the floor.
Move slowly through the full range.
results.description: Lying on Side Arm Circle Warm Up is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Upper Back.

results.name: Major Groups Muscle Body
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight, arms by your side, and feet shoulder-width apart.
results.description: Major Groups Muscle Body is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category.

results.name: Med Ball Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand with your feet together, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Jump your feet out wide while pressing the ball overhead.
Jump your feet back together as you bring the ball back to your chest.
Repeat at a steady pace.
tips: Land softly on the balls of your feet.
results.description: Med Ball Jumping Jacks is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Calves, Quadriceps.

results.name: Med Ball Side Wall Slams
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall about an arm's length away, holding a medicine ball at your hip.
Rotate away from the wall to load.
Rotate explosively and throw the ball into the wall at hip to chest height.
Catch the rebound and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Pivot your back foot so your hips drive the throw.
Use a ball made for wall throws.
results.description: Med Ball Side Wall Slams is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Med Ball Slam Burpees
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball overhead.
Slam the ball to the floor in front of you.
Place your hands on the ball or the floor, jump your feet back into a plank, then jump them back in.
Pick up the ball, stand and lift it overhead into the next rep.
tips: Use a slam ball that doesn't bounce.
Keep your back flat when you pick up the ball.
results.description: Med Ball Slam Burpees is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Abdominals, Quadriceps.

results.name: Monkey Bar Swings
instructions: Hang from the first bar of a monkey bar set with both hands.
Swing your body slightly and reach one hand forward to the next bar.
Shift your weight and swing the other hand forward to the following bar.
Continue across the bars, keeping your shoulders engaged.
tips: Use your hips to create a gentle swing.
Keep a firm grip and active shoulders.
results.description: Monkey Bar Swings is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Shoulders, Core.
